title: Accessory and Computers ordering is now live!
firstParagraph: Our newest release introduced the Accessory and Computer catalogs and associated order processes. This release includes:
bullet1: A modernized look and additional functionality to the i-o order flows you are familiar with
bullet2: Consistency between old and new i-o, where users will see the same Accessory and Computer catalog items, orders, and pending approvals in each system
bullet3: Orders display and management on the Orders & Incidents page
bullet4: Approver view to act on orders pending your action
bullet5: Ability to order on behalf of another user by engaging the "ORDER NOW" user lookup tool from the home page
